title: Electric field (তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র)
placement: Book page 283, topic 10.5 তড়িৎ ক্ষেত্র, চিত্র ১০.১১–১০.১৩ and the field-line rules (pp. 283–286).
description: The electric field and its lines (pages 283–286, topic 10.5). A polished metal sphere on a clear acrylic stand on a plain sand bench in a calm deep-blue space, and a small test charge q₀ (the book's word on p.287) on its own stand. Field lines are traced from the real field E = kq/r² (added as vectors) in 3D: light-gold tubes with a dark outline and outlined arrowheads; the force on q₀ is an outlined teal arrow F = Eq. Six steps, one tap each, slow: (1) the sphere is charged + and its lines grow out in every direction (চিত্র ১০.১১, rule a); (2) q₀ is brought to half the distance, E four times (2,500 → 10,000 N/C, with q = 4 nC), with the E–r graph (1/r²) in the panel (rule c); (3) the charge made −: the lines draw in from all round, F reversed; (4) a second sphere −q: the lines of +q end on −q (চিত্র ১০.১২ a, rule d); (5) both +: the lines bend apart and q₀ in the middle feels no force, E = 0 (চিত্র ১০.১২ b); (6) −2q and +q: twice the lines on −2q (চিত্র ১০.১৩, rule b). q₀ can be dragged (one charge; between the like pair, to find E = 0), with a live E reading and graph. 'সমতলে দেখো' shows the book's flat cut: only the lines in one plane. A calm intro card, the kit's how-to row, a five-question test (the hidden sign, 1/r², the zero point, more lines, lines never cross). Phone-first, Bangla and English.
